name: Sandbag Bear-Hug Squat
steps: Wrap both arms around the bag at chest height and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly turned out.
Brace your core and upper back tightly to keep the sandbag pinned high against your torso.
Bend your hips and knees to sit between your feet, stopping while you can keep your trunk steady and heels planted.
Drive forcefully through your midfoot and heels to extend your hips and knees back to standing.
tips: Keep your upper back engaged so the sandbag does not drag your torso forward into a rounded posture.
Keep your knees tracking in line with your toes throughout the entire squat.
